column1: # Context-aware script spellings. Save, then Reload configuration. Common mode only.
# Three TAB-separated columns: Roman phrase, Devanagari phrase, Bengali phrase.
# At least two words; each output must have the same word count as its input.
# Longest matching phrase wins; spaces/Tabs/NBSP are preserved. Never matches across a newline.
# Leave one target column empty to use normal conversion for that target.
